audience: brokers, appraisers and analysts who check Saudi property prices against registered deals

useCases.title: Estimate a property's value from nearby deals
useCases.text: Look up a property by its RER number, then find recent deals on nearby properties to use as comparable sales.

useCases.title: Compare deal volume and value across districts
useCases.text: Get the number of deals and the total deal value for a city or district over a date range. Break the result down by category and property type.

useCases.title: Rank the largest deals in a city
useCases.text: Rank the highest or lowest deals in a city or district by total price, price per m² or area, for a date range.

useCases.title: Pull the deal list for a district and plan
useCases.text: Search deals by date, location, plan, unit, category, property type, price or area. Each row shows price per m², area and any mortgage or gift flag.

useCases.title: Review the deal history of a land plot
useCases.text: Look up matching records by RER number, or by state, city, m566 and unit. Read each record's deal history before a valuation or sale.
